doc_friction.issue: pyenv.py printed /usr/bin/python3.13 (already had numpy/scipy/pytest); plain python3 lacks numpy, so every command needed the explicit interpreter. Not wrong, but the bare python3 in CLAUDE.md's check commands only works because they are stdlib.

deviations.why: 5n's Next said 'replace q_min with the PVG 32 bypass-closing law'; on reflection any closing law gives pump pressure >= load pressure at full fixed flow, so the closing law cannot remove q_min (a property of the trace's noise).
deviations.did: measured q_min as the data's noise floor and added a closing-law-free floor (dp_spool 0) instead
